architecture.scope: Repository placeholder with README and license; a language workbench, compiler pipeline and runtime are not yet evidenced.
architecture.runtime_boundary: No executable application or build target is confirmed.
architecture.composition_rule: Create a language specification, grammar, parser contract and test fixtures before attempting a monolithic implementation.

preserved_boundaries: Do not infer a compiler or language runtime from the repository title.
Keep language specification, parser, semantic model and execution backend independently testable.
forbidden_composition: No fabricated language features or working compiler claims.
No implicit runtime dependency on SAMBU or another project.
gaps: Define the language product scope and syntax charter.
Add grammar, lexer/parser and AST test fixtures.
Choose a build target and publish reproducible development instructions.
